0.1.0.readme:
# Factory CLI

R2-backed artifact registry CLI.

## Usage

```bash
bun run factory --version
bun run factory:publish ./dist.tgz --name my-lib --version 1.0.0
bun run factory:list
bun run factory:search event-store
bun run factory:install my-lib
bun run factory:readme my-lib
bun run factory create factory-library my-new-lib --publish
```

## Environment

Set `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` for registry access.
Optional: `FACTORY_REGISTRY_URL`, `BUN_CREATE_DIR`, `FACTORY_NO_COLOR`.
